note: Registered cell expectations for Study 018, locked-replication stratum, revised at review round 1. Layers: currency = Study 016's frozen registry/verify_currency.py, a digest-pinned unmodified upstream reporting membership at snapshot and nothing more; transition = this study's rule evaluator (rule/SPEC.md), which is evaluated ONLY over an authenticated membership answer - 'pass' or exactly 'fail:not-current-at-snapshot' - and refuses every other currency outcome rather than reinterpreting it (round-1 R1-1). Membership at each cited prefix is computed by the pinned upstream's OWN fold, so lifecycle semantics are the upstream's by construction (round-1 R1-2). Expected values are adjudicated layer OUTCOME strings: 'pass'/'usable', 'unavailable', or '<verdict>:<code>'. combined is usable only when both layers permit it. Roles: endpoint rows decide R1; control-gate rows are validity gates evaluated first; descriptive and demonstration rows are published and count toward nothing. registeredUndetected marks a permissive outcome that is itself the registered finding. identityGroups registers deliberate byte-identity, verified by the scorer: bnd-backdated-citation IS div-grandfather-on-cited-support's bytes and bnd-mint-time-refusal IS cite-absent-stop-unaffected's - each is one adjudication carrying a second reading, so both are excluded from the endpoint count rather than inflating it. expectedRuleEvidence (citedPosition, retiredAtPosition) is adjudicated as its own transition:<field> divergence channel, so a cell cannot reach its registered outcome from the wrong position; R1 counts those channels.

Membership alone therefore does not determine reliance (RFC 0011 section 2a); this study takes no position on who states the rule or where it is evaluated

cells.construction: BYTE-IDENTICAL to div-grandfather-on-cited-support, read as an artifact whose author chose which head to cite
cells.note: REGISTERED EXPECTED-UNDETECTED, and DESCRIPTIVE rather than an endpoint (round-1 R1-8): every input, expected outcome and registered evidence value equals div-grandfather-on-cited-support's, so it is one adjudication carrying two readings, not two results, and it is excluded from R1 credit and from the endpoint count. The identity IS the finding: honest reliance and backdated reliance are the same evidence, so no rule over this evidence separates them, and signing the citation changes nothing because the party that would sign chooses what to cite (RFC 0011 Unresolved #3/#11)

cells.construction: the same evidence; position-window naming a DURATION window (24h) instead of a position count
cells.note: the ordering limit as a verdict: the only ordering available offline is positional, effectiveFrom is carried and never compared in the pinned upstream, and nothing holds a clock. A reader may object that a position window is not what an organisation means by '24 hours' - that objection IS this cell, and the study does not defend the model

cells.construction: BYTE-IDENTICAL to cite-absent-stop-unaffected, re-read as the answer a producer's own check would have returned at mint time
cells.note: DEMONSTRATION, published and never counted (round-1 R1-9): no producer stage, mint event, accepted-head policy or freshness rule exists in this apparatus, so the mint-time reading is prose over an existing adjudication and the identity is registered rather than left implicit. RFC 0011 Unresolved #11 makes such refusal conditional on a separately specified producer policy, which this study does not supply
